body:
Maybe we can be more explicit. How about:
 
"_The underlying QAOA object does not seem to have any intermediate measurement result. Please, consider saving intermediate measurements during optimization by setting `optimization_progress=True` in your workflow._"

Or a less verbose version of it: the important thing (I think) is to give the end user a pointer to what they need to do in order to use this feature :)

On the other hand, maybe we could return also mean and std for some percentiles? What do you think?
